interpretation.intent: Expose the same branching structure while replacing list constructors with f and the empty list with z.
rules: Colons identify the left tree's list constructors.
Both trees share numbered leaf positions and spine geometry; numbered branches clear their constructor glyphs.
Only constructor and terminal labels change between trees.
Use original vector construction, not pixels or assets copied from the reference image.
No background rectangle, enclosing border, or boxed nodes.
